title: Fold the review-round rules into one record: round 3 only for a guard or check change that failed a round
why: Owner 15:44 CST Nov 10 (R9, RD a, relayed by the retrospective session): "yeah i never wanted round 3 if it passed earlier and was so confused to see that it was occuring"; "agreed A -- can look into the sonnet noise thing later". SIGHTING 05:43 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 05:42, runner 10's `merge --reviewed` at 05:40 CST; unread by triage): the tool reads claude-settings #3399 (head 8472ca8bf749, record 6876644473, Guard or check: yes) as "done: round 1 is FAIL, and the fix check passed", so it owes no round 3. The root CLAUDE.md the coordinator holds (rule roles-review-cap-three) still says "Only a guard or check change fixed under a fix verifier also waits for round 3", and the coordinator told runner 11 so for home #730. TRIAGE'S READ, from ruling R9 (owner 18:35 CST Nov 13, "that's correct"; read in roadmap/rulings/r9.json, not merge.py): "A fix after a pass, lint-only or a finding fix, is checked by a fix verifier, and its pass ends review. Round 3 runs only when round 2 FAILS." R9 itself names the root clause as stale: "its stale clause ... is still to be rewritten; owner's yes needed". So the tool follows R9 and the root rule text is the stale side; the mismatch is the known unrewritten clause, not a new defect. Triage did not read merge.py. R9 speaks of a fix after a PASS; #3399 is a fix after a round 1 FAIL. Whether R9 covers that exact case is not stated in the ruling text triage read, and the tool has decided it does. Until the root text is rewritten, sessions reading it are misled (this one too). OWNER ITEM 833 05:44 CST Nov 14 (pick-r3-after-failed-fix-check), asked by the coordinator 05:44: (a) done at the fix check pass, rewrite the root clause in place to match R9 and the tool; (b) round 3 still runs after a fix check pass on a guard or check change, keep the root text and change the tool. No star. Why an item: page item 741's reply promised the stale root clause "comes to you as its own yes", and triage found no such item; item 739 (the same failed-then-fixed question) was withdrawn 12:32 CST Nov 13 by the retrospective and never answered by the owner. Not measured: round 3 after a round 1 FAIL fixed under a fix check. Until he answers, the tool decides and no rule text changes. SECOND SIGHTING 05:55 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 05:55; unread by triage): home #730 merged with no round 3 owed (round 1 FAIL, fix check PASS), the same tool reading as #3399. Item 833 is open; the tool decides meanwhile.
note: Round 1 runs Sonnet for a guard or check change, the role's model otherwise (item 359 a, not on main; #1552). Fixes are verified per glossary ruling G5. Correction (owner, 16:07 CST Nov 10, relayed): the record picks item 471 a. A guard or check change that passes round 1 is done. Only a change fixed under a fix check waits for round 3. The net-value test runs only for an unclear case that cannot finish (the 2026-10-15 valve). Rewrite CLAUDE.md rules roles-third-round-steps-up and roles-review-cap-three to match; merge.py:3566 already follows item 471 a. Deferred note: whether round 1 runs Sonnet for every logic change (Haiku round 1 fails 79% vs 38% Sonnet; noise share unknown). Home: decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3, rewritten in place, or one new rounds record if rulings-declare-kind needs it. Prose wave (owner 20:24 CST Nov 11, item 521; retrospective's sort 20:41 CST): prose after code; it waits behind the code it describes. Facts from lane review-rounds-rework 13:26 CST Nov 12 (PR #2874): only 43 of about 3,000 round-1 records show Sonnet, so item 359 a may not be applied on main; check the spawn. Item 359 c means only a blocker FAILs the round; the review record gains a Findings line (blocker, should-fix, wording counts) so the noise share in the deferred note can be measured. Measures from lane review-rounds-rework (PR #2874, docs/decisions/review-rounds-measure.md; coordinator 13:30 CST Nov 12): round 1 Haiku about 3,100 records vs Sonnet 43; Haiku FAILs 84% of guard/check heads; round 2 Sonnet FAILs 49%, and 27% of heads Haiku passed; round 3 FAILs 8%, 4.3% after a round-2 PASS; all 9 negative net values follow a round-2 FAIL. Findings per round cannot be measured without a Findings line. Lane field holds a name, no session id: liveness unknown (13:31 CST).
